title: Downloads folder
whyItMatters: Browsers and chat apps save installers, invoices, tickets and photos here. It is often the biggest pile of personal files on the machine.
source: XDG user directories defaults (xdg-user-dirs creates Downloads under the home directory): https://www.freedesktop.org/wiki/Software/xdg-user-dirs/
notes: The folder name comes from ~/.config/user-dirs.dirs and can be localised or renamed, which this rule does not detect. Telegram and some browsers use their own subfolder inside it.

steps: Open the folder named in the plan in your file manager.
Move any downloaded documents, tickets, or installers you want to keep to another location.
Delete the remaining files and folders in Downloads.
Empty the Trash, because deleted files wait there until you do.
cleanup.risk: The files leave the folder; until the Trash is emptied they can still be restored, and after that only copies made elsewhere survive.
cleanup.source: GNOME Help, Visual overview of GNOME: https://help.gnome.org/gnome-help/shell-introduction.html
